goal: For repository-wide retained Actions artifact inventories, attain an accurate storage view across all workflows, demonstrated by independent reconciliation of original report rows with complete source-native workflow, run and artifact API pages.
population: Every workflow in the independent workflow inventory; every non-cancelled run created in [midnight UTC after assigned report_date minus 30 days, midnight UTC after assigned report_date); every retained artifact on those runs, including expired entries returned by the API.

primary.formula: Count distinct repository report-date deliveries completed in the requested disjoint interval whose complete independently reconciled inventory, per-workflow count, bytes, average, latest eligible run and active status match the original report.

independentAcceptance.source: Original GitHub REST JSON bytes with exact repository/run identities, response acquisition timestamps and exhaustive page sequences. Agent assertions and caller-supplied scores/accepted flags are ignored.
independentAcceptance.report: Original published Markdown table, immutable content digest, report date and stable delivery identity; publication must be independently bound to the original content before full delivery credit.
independentAcceptance.coverage: All workflows, all runs in the fixed source window and all run artifact pages must reconcile to API total_count. Missing pages, deleted historical entries, mutable state without contemporaneous preservation, and unavailable report content remain unknown.
independentAcceptance.bytes: Artifact size_in_bytes is authoritative. Report size cells must declare MB or GB; because the source does not specify decimal versus binary units, accept a consistently applied decimal or binary interpretation only when all rounded count/total/average cells agree.
independentAcceptance.time: Run created_at supplies eligibility and latest run date. The immutable assigned report_date supplies the analysis endpoint, not execution wall clock. Cancelled runs are excluded. Latest-run cells must resolve to the exact timestamp or the same UTC calendar date when date-only.
independentAcceptance.status: A workflow with retained artifacts in the window is Active. Workflows without artifacts are omitted, as required by the source. No invented inactive-age threshold.
independentAcceptance.scope: All listed artifacts count, not only successful-run artifacts. Artifact IDs must be globally unique and run bindings must agree. Known checked workflow subtotals survive missing broader scope.
independentAcceptance.delivery: Count each stable delivery identity once, at independent publication completion time, never by retaining a prior inventory snapshot. Workflow contribution additionally needs an independently bound original run, source path and head revision.
independentAcceptance.safeguards: A valid original work-queue Claim, immutable report_date and matching profile are separate requirements for current workflow-linked delivery. Narrative insight correctness, retention-policy interpretation and optimization benefit remain unknown without independent evidence.

metrics: verified-workflows: native partial progress, independently reconciled workflow rows
verified-storage-bytes: native exact integer artifact bytes in independently reconciled workflow rows
workflow-linked delivery: separately unavailable until independently bound original publication/run/Claim receipts can be checked; editable markers are not numeric contribution evidence
rejectedProxies: Published report counts without independent accuracy validation
Artifact counts or byte totals alone
Editable tracking markers and body references
Trajectory recurrence graders, which do not check inventory accuracy
historicalApplicability: The repository problem predates automation. This is a prospective complete-known-source instrument, not a claim of workflow adoption or exhausted historical evidence. Earlier eras require their contemporaneous source and independent inventory receipts. The observed source-addition candidate has a readable tree but its original source and compiled blob content are unavailable locally.
zeroVersusMissing: Zero requires a complete independent delivery/opportunity census and complete native acceptance evidence. No local receipts means unknown, never zero deliveries or no opportunities.
